import { Component } from '@angular/core'; @Component({ selector: 'app-footer', templateUrl: './footer.component.html', styleUrls: ['./footer.component.css'] }) export class FooterComponent { year = new Date().getFullYear(); links = [ { label: 'About', href: '#about' }, { label: 'Skills', href: '#skills' }, { label: 'Experience', href: '#experience' }, { label: 'Projects', href: '#projects' }, { label: 'Contact', href: '#contact' } ]; scrollTo(href: string): void { const el = document.querySelector(href); if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }); } scrollToTop(): void { window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }); } }
